title: 第二十五章 许哥别坑我第二十六章 灵符显威
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
夜深人静，苦修洞酣声如雷。
宗门劳作强度之大，就连修士都扛不住。
大多弟子修行个把时辰，就草草进入梦乡。
盘膝坐在洞穴中央，许天手里攥着是白天从天符院顺来的几张废符。
“能不能成，就看这一哆嗦了。”
深吸一口气，他神念一动，将它们送入黑鼎空间。
嗡。
熟悉的震感传来。
黑鼎并未像炼丹那样喷出丹香。
而是炉身发红，鼎盖上那符文开始游走。
仅仅三息。
鼎盖微张，三张崭新符箓飘了出来，悬浮在空间内。
许天定睛一看，欣喜绽放。
成功了。
原本那几张符纸材质低劣，画工更是惨不忍睹，灵力断断续续。
可现在？
这三张符箓通体流畅，其上符文也是笔走龙蛇，一气呵成。
仅仅是看一眼，就能感觉到火灵气。
虽说只有淡淡一层，但现如今，已是足够。
“普通的火弹符......”

仔细感悟一番后，许天心中狂跳：“这灵压波动......恐怕达到入品级别的符咒！”
在修仙界，符咒分不入流和入品。
天符院那些弟子画的，大多是不入流的戏法。
而一旦入品，哪怕是一品下阶，也是价值不菲。
根据行情，一张至少能卖五块下品灵石！
五块下品灵石！
要知道，50点贡献点才能换一枚下品灵石！
仅仅三息功夫，是李狗蛋干五天的工钱，是他许天干十天的血汗钱！
“发了......这次是真的发了！”
许天按捺住激动，将三张火弹符取出。
指尖触碰灵符，感受其中传来的火系灵气，终是放下心来。
“黑鼎不仅能提纯丹药，还能自动修复符箓的纹路！”
“废符变极品......这天符院哪里是垃圾场，分明是我的私人金库。”
收好符箓，许天看向旁边像死猪一样昏睡的李狗蛋。
这家伙白天被打得不轻，梦里还在哼哼唧唧喊着“别打脸”。
“不过，符咒是成了，效果如果还尚且不得知。”
“不加以测试，万一有问题，那财路就断了。”
许天目光幽幽。
他在天符院捣腾废符，需要时间，更需要掩护。
李狗蛋吸引的火力越多，他就越安全。
content_en:
In the dead of night, people are quiet, and the sound of the penance cave is like thunder.
The sect's workload is so intense that even the monks can't bear it.
Most disciples practice for a few hours and then fall asleep.
Sitting cross-legged in the middle of the cave, Xu Tian held in his hands several useless talismans that he had brought from Tianfuyuan during the day.
"Whether it works or not depends on this trembling."
Taking a deep breath, he sent them into the black cauldron space with a thought.
Buzz.
A familiar tremor came.
The black cauldron did not emit the fragrance of elixirs like alchemy.
Instead, the furnace body turned red, and the runes on the cauldron cover began to wander.
Just three breaths.
The lid of the tripod opened slightly, and three brand-new talismans floated out, suspended in the space.
Xu Tian took a closer look and burst into joy.
It worked.
The materials of the original talisman papers were poor, the painting work was even worse, and the spiritual power was intermittent.
But now?
These three talismans are all smooth, and the runes on them are also written in one go.
Just by looking at it, you can feel the fire aura.
Although it is only a faint layer, it is enough now.
"Ordinary fire bullet charm..."
After carefully comprehending it, Xu Tian's heart beat wildly: "This fluctuation in spiritual pressure... I'm afraid it has reached the level of a first-class talisman!"
In the world of immortality, there is no distinction between high-grade and high-grade talismans.
Most of the paintings painted by the disciples of Tianfu Academy were inferior tricks.
And once it reaches the first level, even if it is a lower level first level, it is still worth a lot of money.
According to the market situation, one piece can be sold for at least five low-grade spiritual stones!
Five low-grade spiritual stones!
You know, only 50 contribution points can be exchanged for a low-grade spiritual stone!
In just three breaths, it was Li Godan’s five days’ wages, and Xu Tian’s ten days’ hard-earned money!
"I posted it...I really posted it this time!"
Xu Tian suppressed his excitement and took out three fire bullet talismans.
Touching the talisman with his fingertips and feeling the fire aura coming from it, he finally felt relieved.
"The black cauldron can not only purify the elixir, but also automatically repair the texture of the talisman!"
"Trash talismans turned into top quality... This Tianfuyuan is not a garbage dump, it is clearly my private treasury."
Putting the talisman away, Xu Tian looked at Li Goudan, who was sleeping like a dead pig next to him.
This guy was beaten badly during the day, and he was still moaning and screaming "Don't slap me in the face" in his dream.
"However, the spell has been completed, but the effect is still unknown."
“If you don’t test it, if something goes wrong, your financial path will be cut off.”
Xu Tian's eyes were dark.
He was messing around with useless talismans in Tianfuyuan. He needed time and even more cover.
The more firepower Li Goudan attracts, the safer he is.
